archetype_description: Luxury & Authority. Moody dark theme with a premium Webflow studio feel, grounded by Swiss/Brutalist typography confidence and selective high-contrast lime accents.

rules: Use --surface for cards, inputs, and modals.
Use --surface-2 for hover states or nested containers.
Use --line for all dividers and borders (hairline 1px).
Use --ink for primary text and icons.
Use --muted for secondary text, timestamps, and placeholders.
Use --lime EXTREMELY sparingly: CTA pills, 'one million lives' highlight, active states. NEVER use for body text.
Use --violet as an optional secondary accent only if absolutely necessary.
Headings (h1-h3) must use display font with tight tracking (-0.5px to -1.4px) and tight leading (leading-none or leading-tight).
Body text should have generous line height (leading-relaxed, ~1.7).
Use Italianno ONLY for pull-quotes or a single hero flourish (never body).
NEVER use the word 'clarity' in any copy.

visual_enhancers: Faint radial lime glows behind heroes: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, rgba(188,234,62,0.1), transparent 60%).
Optional subtle film-grain/noise overlay on the body background for a premium tactile feel.
NO heavy drop shadows. Rely on borders and background shifts for depth.

rules: Scroll-driven storytelling: fade/translate/clip reveals for text and images.
Staggered children animations for lists and grids.
Magnetic/hover-lift cards and buttons (e.g., hover:-translate-y-1 transition-transform duration-300).
Optional tasteful custom cursor on interactive media.

nav.description: Sticky blurred dark navbar with logo and links.
nav.classes: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 bg-bg/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-line
nav.logo: Text mark 'do' using display font, or a custom SVG.
nav.mobile: Hamburger menu opening a full-screen overlay menu with staggered link reveals.

button.primary: bg-lime text-bg font-semibold rounded-full px-6 py-3 hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(188,234,62,0.3)] transition-all
button.ghost: text-ink border border-line rounded-full px-6 py-3 hover:bg-surface-2 transition-all
button.link: text-ink underline decoration-line hover:decoration-lime underline-offset-4 transition-all

cards.book: bg-surface border border-line rounded-[20px] overflow-hidden group hover:border-muted transition-colors. Cover image inside with subtle scale on hover.
cards.stat: bg-surface-2 border border-line rounded-[20px] p-6 flex flex-col items-center justify-center
cards.post: flex flex-col gap-4 group. Cover image rounded-[16px] overflow-hidden. Lime category pill absolute top-4 right-4.

marquee_cta.description: Lime CTA band with marquee 'Let's Get Started'.
marquee_cta.classes: bg-lime text-bg py-4 overflow-hidden flex whitespace-nowrap text-2xl font-display font-medium uppercase tracking-tight

sections: Hero: Eyebrow + Italic display mission line ('one million lives' in lime) + sub-line + CTAs (Explore Programmes, Watch Debo') + Portrait + Floating stat card. Faint lime radial glow + grain.
About Teaser: Portrait + 'A Bold & Brilliant Transformation Architect' + Read My Story link.
Books Showcase (Replacing Pricing): Featured book at top + grid below (large covers, title, one-liner, Get the book). Art-directed bookshelf feel.
Impact Stats: Animated count-ups + tag chips (Faith-Rooted, Practically Delivered, etc.).
Publications Strip: 5 academic works + 'Access all' link.
Testimonials: Slider/Grid with REAL quotes. Placeholders must be attributed 'to be supplied', no fake names.
Newsletter Capture: Minimalist form inside a surface card.
Lime CTA Band: Marquee 'Let's Get Started'.

about.notes: Generous imagery, timeline or story-driven text, cinematic speaking-on-stage hero.

books.notes: Storefront feel. Featured book hero + bookshelf grid. Each gets cover, description, buy-link.

publications.notes: Academic list style. Clean, structural, high contrast.

journal.list_notes: Grid of posts with lime category pills.
journal.post_notes: Clean reading layout, generous measure (~720px max-w), Italianno blockquote accent.

admin.notes: Auth-gated (Supabase). Clean dashboard, list view, rich-text editor (bold/italic/headings/quote/lists/link/image/cover/category/status). Auto-slug.

contact.notes: Form + Book Appointment CTA + Email + Socials.

technical_instructions.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case based on role (e.g., data-testid='book-appointment-button').
technical_instructions.css_setup: Define the CSS variables in the :root and dark mode scope in index.css. Setup Tailwind config to use these CSS variables.
technical_instructions.shadcn_customization: Avoid standard shadcn 'card' component for marketing sections if it feels too rigid. Use raw HTML/Tailwind for custom layouts. If using shadcn components, heavily customize them to match the dark luxury aesthetic.
